entities.summary: Jan Gehl Hon. FAIA is a Danish architect and urban design consultant based in Copenhagen whose career has focused on improving the quality of urban life by re-orienting city design towards the pedestrian and cyclist. He is a founding partner of Gehl Architects. Jan Gehl was a architects & engineers from Copenhagen (b. 1936-09-17, Copenhagen). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
